1.en_consolidated_definition:
To have someone thoroughly disgusted or fed up.

Alternatively:

To be utterly disenchanted with something or someone.

Or more formally:

To be completely satiated to the point of disgust or utter dissatisfaction.

Note: Las opciones anteriores son equivalentes y todas mantienen el significado exacto de la definición original.
